name: ExpressLT™ Gel Cable
description: Our team designs ExpressLT™ gel-filled fiber optic cables to deliver exceptional durability and long-term protection in demanding outdoor environments. These loose tube stranded outside plant fiber optic cables use water-blocking gel to safeguard fibers against moisture, ensuring consistent performance in wet or high-humidity conditions. The rugged construction in dielectric or armored versions makes ExpressLT™ gel cables ideal for underground and aerial installations across broadband and telecom networks. Fiber strand counts from 4 to 432.
specs: Reverse oscillating stranded core; Available with ezPREP® armor; Armored cable access, bonding; Grounding are faster, easier, and safer; 2.5 mm buffer tubes with enhanced flexibility

name: MassLink™ Multi-Tube Ribbon Cable
description: Spinel's MassLink™ Multi-Tube Flat Ribbon Loose Tube Cable is an excellent solution, offering a compact, lightweight, and easy-to-handle ribbon cable design. Prysmian has recently re-engineered the cable for fiber counts ranging from 288 to 360 fibers, using a 5-at-1 core configuration. This design reduces the outer diameter (OD), enabling higher-density ribbon cables to fit into smaller pathways.
specs: Efficient packaging of higher fiber counts; Lightweight and easy to handle during installation;  Allows for ease of stripping and fiber breakout; Time and labor savings during fiber splicing; Tested in accordance with PE-90, 7CFR 1755.900; Relevant EIA/ TIA-455 series FOTPs for fiber optic cables

name: LT 2.0 Dry Loose Tube Cable
description: Spinel’s LT2.0 Loose Tube Cable features an innovative design that offers numerous benefits. The LT2.0 is equipped with 2.0mm buffer tubes, resulting in a cable outer diameter (OD) that is up to 20% smaller than that of a standard loose tube cable with 2.5mm buffer tubes. In today’s telecom industry, both hardware space and cable pathways are at a premium.
specs: Incorporation of industry-leading bend-insensitive single-mode (SM) fiber; Options available for up to 432 fibers; Reduced cable OD reduces the LT2.0's weight by 30%; Counts up to 456 can be placed in a 1-inch duct

name: Central Loose Tube 600 Cable
description: Spinel’s Central Loose Tube 600 Cable offers an efficient design combining performance and benefits. It features a single, central loose tube with ezPrep® armor, making it a suitable, cost-effective option for low-fiber-count applications. This central loose tube cable allows easy cable entry and flexible routing, accommodating multi-purpose installations of up to 24 fibers.
specs: Enhanced 600-pound tensile rating; Single central loose tube design; Lightweight and compact construction; ezPrep® armor speeds up cable access; Armored construction for  superior crush resistance and mechanical durability; Compliant with GR-20, ICEA, and IEC standards

name: Central Loose Tube 300 Cable
description: Spinel’s Central Loose Tube 300 cable is an excellent cost-effective 300 lb. tensile-rated design for low fiber counts and provides flexible routing, including multi-purpose drop applications.
specs: ezPrep® armor greatly improves mid-entry; Optional ripcord speeds cable entry; Flexible gel or dry buffer tube; Standard bend-insensitive single-mode fiber;

name: 48-432f FusionLink™ with FlexRibbon® Technology Cable
description: FusionLink™ with FlexRibbon® Technology features an ultra-compact design for outside plant cables, accommodating between 48 and 432 bend-insensitive fibers. FlexRibbon technology allows the fiber ribbons to be rolled and packed together within a small-diameter subunit
specs: Ribbon-in-central-tube (RICT) design; Compact and lightweight structure; Rollable, intermittently bonded ribbons; Supports up to 432 fibers in a reduced-diameter design; Meets GR-20, ICEA, and IEC standards;

name: 288-432f FusionLink™ with FlexRibbon® Dry Cable
description: FusionLink™ with FlexRibbon® Technology offers an ultra-compact design for outside plant cables that supports 288 to 432 bend-insensitive fibers. By using FlexRibbon technology, the fibers are rolled and packed tightly into a small-diameter buffer tube. This high packing density allows for efficient use of space while preserving the advantages of mass fusion splicing for the 200 µm fiber ribbons.
specs: Compact ribbon-in-central-tube (RICT) design; Contains 288 to 432 fibers; Rollable ribbon construction; Reduced diameter and lightweight design; Compliant with GR-20, ICEA, and IEC standards;
